blocker_detail: The skill's entire deliverable (a working LLM call, a configured agent, or listing /v1/models) depends on a live, branch-scoped NEON_AI_GATEWAY_TOKEN and NEON_AI_GATEWAY_BASE_URL. This office-assistant runtime cannot create or access a Neon account, cannot obtain a Neon credential/token, and (separately) cannot run any CLI or code at all (no shell/code execution is granted), so the `neon deploy` provisioning step and any actual HTTP call to a real gateway host (e.g. via curl or an SDK) cannot be performed. I did not fabricate a token, base URL, or a mocked response, per the task rules. I can only write the client-side integration code as inert text files (e.g. an OpenAI-SDK snippet targeting ${NEON_AI_GATEWAY_BASE_URL}/v1) and reference documentation notes, but I cannot execute it or verify a real response, so the core deliverable ('deliver a working inference request') is not actually achieved or verified.
